items.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
items.q: You ever heard of Tucker, Pepper Grace?

ctx.x: What can 15 cents do? 15 cents can't get a cut of the back, but now. Sure. But I tell you what, I wished a lot of time, now I can see way back days, when things were really cheap. If I'd tell you all what I have did, you wouldn't believe me. Only time was hard. You ever heard of Tucker, Pepper Grace?
